repo.description:
### Impact

OpenBao may leak sensitive information in the audit logs when processing malformed data. Data leakage occurs when sending a request to a plugin which contains malformed data on fields of type `TypeKVPair` or `TypeHeader`; the error will appear in the audit log similarly to GHSA-8f5r-8cmq-7fmq. 

This vulnerability is original to HashiCorp Vault.

### Patch

OpenBao's builtin plugins have been patched in v2.6.3 and v2.7.0. The SDK plugins rely on has been patched in v2.6.3 and v2.7.1.
repo.summary: OpenBao Plugins May Leak Malformed TypeKVPair and TypeHeader Parameters in Audit Log
